content: शश्वत् {%ind.%} .²1 Perpetually, eternally, for ever. .²2 Constantly, repeatedly, always, frequently, again and again; जीवन् पुनः शश्वदुपप्लवेभ्यः (पासि) <ls>R. 2. 48</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 70</ls>; <ls>Mu. 3. 19</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 73. 14</ls>; <ls>Me. 57</ls>. (In <ab>comp.</ab> शश्वत् may be translated by ‘lasting, eternal’; as शश्वच्छान्ति eternal tranquillity.)
